_about: Entries whose identifier was built, trained or tuned on (part of) this benchmark's files — their score is partly accuracy on their own test data. Keys are entry-name prefixes; counts are of this benchmark's 455 files, by git blob id. A value is either a text (the whole benchmark is that entry's home turf) or {"why", "cases_tag" or "cases"}: only those cases are; the overall leaderboard then counts the entry, held out, on the other cases.
Rouge: its test suite lexes every one of these files (spec/lexers_spec.rb: each sample must round-trip, each demo must lex without error): the lexers were written against them. Its guessing is not tested on them (the guessing specs use file names, MIME types and short sources)

Chroma.why: 1 file (the YANG sample) is an input of Chroma's lexer tests (lexers/testdata/yang.actual, checked at a6d00fe)

GitHub Linguist.why: 1 file (the Fluent demo) is byte-identical to a Linguist sample (samples/Fluent/simple.ftl, added in v7.15.0, 2021: in every Linguist release run here; tag `linguist-sample`)

go-enry.why: the same Fluent demo (go-enry 2.8.9 and 2.9.6 are generated from Linguist releases that have that sample)
